name: Juarros de Voltoya (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, white at the lower hoist and green at the upper fly, charged towards the hoist with the crowned municipal arms of Juarros de Voltoya (trees and fish on white).
history: Municipal flag of Juarros de Voltoya; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Juarros de Voltoya arms — trees and fish on white
cap of the crown of the arms
